text: {"C1":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent opens with company name, her own name, and an offer of help in the first line.","evidence":"Gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza, le atiende Fernanda Cota. ... ¿En qué le ayudo?"},"C2":{"score":5,"justification":"The agent gathered the policy number and confirmed the vehicle, but otherwise simply answered each question reactively without probing the caller's full situation (e.g., the reason for the inquiry, the caller's relationship/authorization, or whether the brother needed any action taken).","evidence":"Ah, claro. ¿Tiene el número de póliza de su hermano?"},"C3":{"score":10,"justification":"Recording disclosure is delivered in the very first line and no prohibited statements appear; the deductible figure is hedged and attributed to the adjuster's note rather than presented as a binding guarantee.","evidence":"Le aviso que this call may be recorded for quality."},"C4":{"score":10,"justification":"Every question the caller raised (coverage, premium, open claim status, deductible, renewal date) was answered and the caller confirmed the matter was fully handled.","evidence":"Perfecto, con eso tengo. Muchas gracias, señorita, muy amable."},"C5":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent was courteous and efficient throughout, let the caller finish each question, and kept the call on track with a polite close.","evidence":"Para servirle. Que le vaya muy bien y gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza."}}
